source.author: lucan
source.text: Sic plena laborat Phemonoe Phoebo, dum te, consultor operti Castalia tellure dei, vix invenit, Appi, Inter fata diu quaerens tam magna latentem.
source.text_original: Sic plena laborat / Phemonoe Phoebo, dum te, consultor operti / Castalia tellure dei, vix invenit, Appi, / Inter fata diu quaerens tam magna latentem.
source.text_english: So full of Phoebus, Phemonoe labors, while she scarcely finds you, Appius, counselor of the hidden god on Castalian ground, seeking you long among the fates, though so great a man lies hidden.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quae classe dehinc effusa procorum bella, quot ad Troiam flentes hiberna Mycenas, quot proceres natosque deum, quae robora cernes oppetere et magnis Asiam concedere fatis.
reuse.text_original: quae classe dehinc effusa procorum / bella, quot ad Troiam flentes hiberna Mycenas, / quot proceres natosque deum, quae robora cernes / oppetere et magnis Asiam concedere fatis.
reuse.text_english: Then, with the fleet unleashed, how many wars of suitors will you see, how many wintering Mycenaeans weeping for Troy, how many nobles and sons of gods, what great men you will see meet their end and yield Asia to mighty fate.
